items.title: Artist management
items.text: Career direction, team building and day-to-day decisions. We work with signed and independent acts, often on short-term deals built around one release or project.

items.title: A&R
items.text: Sound direction, collaborators and song selection, so every release is the right one.

items.title: Distribution and publishing admin
items.text: Delivery, metadata and PRO registration handled properly, so royalties reach the people who earned them.

items.title: Release paperwork
items.text: Split sheets, producer agreements and featured-artist agreements, cleared before release day.

items.title: Rollout, PR and marketing
items.text: DSP and editorial pitching, press releases, paid social and listening sessions across Nigeria and Ghana.

items.title: Events and brand partnerships
items.text: Event project management in Lagos and Accra, from planning and ticketing to the night itself, and artist partnerships for brands that want the right voice.
